mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT b.tech_pack_id AS pack_id, s.color_id FROM tp_bom_item_sku s JOIN tp_bom_item b ON b.id = s.bom_item_id WHERE b.tech_pack_id IN #{id} AND s.color_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pack_id, s.color_id

SELECT p.id, p.style_id, s.code AS style_code, s.name AS style_name, p.version, p.create_by, p.create_time FROM tp_tech_pack p JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = p.style_id WHERE p.style_id IS NOT NULL AND p.status = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY p.create_time, p.id

SELECT p.id,p.style_id,p.sample_id,s.company_id,p.stage,p.status,p.version,p.version_lock,p.version_note, p.source_pack_id,source.version AS source_version,p.publish_by,p.publish_time,p.create_by,p.create_time,p.update_time FROM tp_tech_pack p JOIN dev_sample s ON s.id=p.sample_id LEFT JOIN tp_tech_pack source ON source.id=p.source_pack_id WHERE s.tenant_key=#{tenant} AND s.company_id=#{companyId} AND s.id=#{sampleId} AND s.deleted_token=0 AND p.style_id IS NULL AND p.stage='DEV' AND p.version < #{beforeVersion} ORDER BY p.version DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id,p.style_id,p.sample_id,s.company_id,p.stage,p.status,p.version,p.version_lock FROM tp_tech_pack p JOIN dev_sample s ON s.id=p.sample_id WHERE s.tenant_key=#{tenant} AND s.company_id=#{companyId} AND s.id=#{sampleId} AND s.deleted_token=0 AND p.style_id IS NULL AND p.stage='DEV' ORDER BY p.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF p

SELECT count(*) FROM tp_tech_pack p JOIN dev_sample s ON s.id=p.sample_id WHERE s.tenant_key=#{tenant} AND s.company_id=#{companyId} AND s.id=#{sampleId} AND s.deleted_token=0 AND p.style_id IS NULL AND p.stage='DEV'

SELECT COALESCE(max(p.version),0) FROM tp_tech_pack p JOIN dev_sample s ON s.id=p.sample_id WHERE s.tenant_key=#{tenant} AND s.company_id=#{companyId} AND s.id=#{sampleId} AND s.deleted_token=0 AND p.style_id IS NULL AND p.stage='DEV'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tp_tech_pack p JOIN dev_sample s ON s.id=p.sample_id WHERE s.tenant_key=#{tenant} AND s.company_id=#{companyId} AND s.id=#{sampleId})

UPDATE tp_tech_pack p SET style_id=#{styleId},version_lock=p.version_lock+1, update_by=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() FROM dev_sample s WHERE s.id=p.sample_id AND s.tenant_key=#{tenant} AND s.company_id=#{companyId} AND s.id=#{sampleId} AND s.deleted_token=0 AND s.status='PASSED' AND p.style_id IS NULL AND p.stage='DEV'
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tp_tech_pack bad WHERE bad.sample_id=#{sampleId} AND bad.style_id IS NULL AND bad.stage='DEV' AND (bad.version_lock >= 2147483647 OR bad.version_lock < 0))
